text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We've been requested to make a video by the person in charge of the academy's PR. As we're getting ready…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I can't believe you agreed to help on such short notice!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Haaah ha ha ha! It is but my fate to be drawn to the stage!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Now, let us carve my beauty into the digital world!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Whoagh! You're as charming as ever today! …Victory!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Of course we are! I'm gonna be the flower garnishing my oshi's sunny stage!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Both your spirit and your costume are stunning! It's as if I'm escorting you into high society.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Ahhh… thank you! Ohhh, I'm sho glab to be alibe… I'm sho glab I made this for my Umas' shake!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Oho. So, you've put special attention into your outfit, yes?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Th-that's right! I've already thought up at least a hundred different design ideas for how to accentuate the cuteness of all the other Umamusume while we race!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: The most important thing is using white as a base color! I was very careful to pick a material that would really make the other racers pop, and I did a pretty good job if I do say so myself!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Ah, and I chose a color scheme meant to blend in with the colors of all the others!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Oh, and the reason for all the little accessories sprinkled all over was because I wanted to be like an accessory to the other Umas! To complement them! And then, after that…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: …Ah! My apologies! I got carried away! So sorry!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Bravo! You've thought long and hard about each article of clothing!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: While running on the turf yourself, you also perceive its stage from the eyes of a director—a Renaissance girl if I've ever known one!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Whaaa?!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: And more than anything… beyond that attention to detail lies the will and desire to produce the greatest of races, for yourself and for your opponents.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: The footage we're shooting today is meant to bring in new students, correct? I feel confident entrusting the details to you.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: What? What?! You want to give that kind of responsibility to me?! Wh-wh-what should I do, Trainer?!
choice_data_list: Let's make the greatest video that you can think of!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: What? What?! You want to give that kind of responsibility to me?! Wh-wh-what should I do, Trainer?!
choice_data_list: Let's make the greatest video that you can think of!
Let's make the greatest video that you can think of!
Maybe it would be good for you both to collaborate.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Opera O's magnificent existence alone banishes darkness from the world! It'd be a crime for me to monopolize the production!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: One who shines light upon the world is essentially the sun itself! I want that image at the forefront!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: The sun… My, that has a glorious ring to it. Tell me more!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: G-g-give me a minute… I think I'm about to explode with joy! I swear on this outfit I'll make the best video ever!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, the video production proceeds under Agnes Digital's direction.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: …And that's a wrap! I knew having you on board was a game-winning call!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: All that's left is to edit everything. …So, uh… Should I go ahead and do that as well?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Sometimes, it is best to let others take the stage. The Overlord shall sit back and await the beautiful final product.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Haaah ha ha ha!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Ahhh… Bwilliant to da berry end… I swear, I'll simp for her as long as I live!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I wonder what kind of video it'll end up being. Full of anticipation, we disperse for the day.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Even if you can't see which path to take. Even if you lose sight of the guidepost pointing you toward tomorrow…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: …You'll definitely find it—your own personal sun!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Come, let us aim for glory together! Haaah ha ha ha ha!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A place where ambitions take flight. Soar toward your dreams! Tracen Academy!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: How about "Opera O's smile lights up the world" for our concept?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Beautiful! There are no better words to convey said message. What would you say to becoming the promoter for my concerts?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Nngh?! Y-you can't mean that! Oh, I am going to explooooode!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After that, the number of applications to the academy increase, making the promotion video a huge success!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Ohhh! Good thinking! I'm just dying to see Opera O at work!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Then, why don't I write the script and you do the editing? With two leads, we'll have a huge hit on our hands!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Wait a minute… You mean I'm going to be in your story?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: R-r-remember, we're planning to film this! Don't you think adding me would be taking too many liberties?!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: And… action! Come with me!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Ohhh, so this is Tracen Academy?! From here, I shall take my very first step as Overlord!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: …Now, you're going to play an older student. Come stand here and block my path!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Ohohoho! I wonder if a greenhorn like yourself even has what it takes to survive.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Very good! As magnificent as the opening to an epic poem!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: I'm so glad I met you. It's thanks to you that I could become the Overlord!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Hmph… I won't lose next time. Our real fight starts now!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: And that's a wrap! I think we've done a fine job.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: …Pwaaaah! Gasp! Apologies! We were so close the whole time! I didn't touch you, did I?!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Speaking of touching… That's right! I completely forgot the scene where I cradle you in my arms after you fall down in exhaustion!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: KYAAAGHK?! I don't think I'm going to survive this!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Agnes Digital puts her life on the line and manages to finish all the filming!
